query:
SELECT p.id, p.name, p.latin_name, p.conservation_status, p.iucn_id, p.family,
       COUNT(pm.molecule_id) as molecule_count
FROM plants p
LEFT JOIN plant_molecules pm ON pm.plant_id = p.id
WHERE p.conservation_status IN ('CR', 'EN', 'VU', 'NT')
GROUP BY p.id, p.name, p.latin_name, p.conservation_status, p.iucn_id, p.family
ORDER BY FIELD(p.conservation_status, 'CR', 'EN', 'VU', 'NT'), p.name
LIMIT 20;
